profile.subtitleJa: ユダ王エホアハズの母。
profile.summaryJa: 列王記下23:31は、エホアハズの母をハムタルとし、リブナ出身エレミヤの娘と記します。
profile.identityNoteJa: 列王記下23:31は、エホアハズの母ハムタルをリブナのエレミヤの娘と記します。

facts.textJa: ゼデキヤの母もハムタルで、エホアハズの母と同じ父母名を持つと記されています。

primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: Jehoahaz was twenty-three years old when he began to reign; and he reigned three months in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Hamutal the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah.
Zedekiah was twenty-one years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Hamutal the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah.
